release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.18 is a hotfix for a UI freeze triggered by opening Settings -> Appearance. The owner Announcements hub was observing class and child mutations across the entire application subtree, so normal pane and navigation changes could repeatedly re-enter announcement placement while other shell runtimes were updating the DOM. This release narrows that observer to the application layout class only while retaining the dedicated Owner Vault visibility observer. Top/Classic Owner Vault + Announcements placement, Sidebar behavior, owner authority, member announcements, and the protected /api/owner/broadcasts pipeline remain unchanged. Regression coverage rejects restoration of the broad subtree observer, and the exact PR head passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including UI runtime and DOM suites, Windows Consumer E2E including the real Wails/WebView2 shell, and CodeQL before merge and Stable promotion.
